# Support

## Bugs

Use the GitHub **Bug report** issue form and include the TeraRelay version, platform, expected behavior, actual behavior, and the smallest reproducible sequence.

Redact usernames, phone numbers, private file names/content, and any account-specific data before posting logs or screenshots.

## Feature requests

Use the GitHub **Feature request** form and describe the user problem before proposing a solution.

## Security

Do **not** open a public issue for a security vulnerability or anything containing credentials, Telegram session data, API hashes, login codes, 2-step verification passwords, signing material, or private user data.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Yashwanth034/TeraRelay/security/advisories/new).

## Platform scope

The current public release is v0.1.1. Android is ARM64-only, and iOS is simulator-validated only; no signed physical-device IPA is published in v0.1.1.
